title: Greetings and Polite Basics
summary: Greet someone, use essential polite expressions, and close a short interaction.

sketchBlocks.title: Bonjou and Bonswa
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Two useful greetings are:

- **Bonjou!**
- **Bonswa!**

A greeting can stand alone or come before a person's name.

segments.text: A greeting can stand alone or come before a person's name.

sketchBlocks.title: Mèsi, Tanpri, and Padon
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Three short expressions are useful immediately:

- **Mèsi.** — thank you
- **Tanpri.** — please
- **Padon.** — excuse me / sorry

Listen to each as a complete spoken expression.

sketchBlocks.title: Orevwa
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
**Orevwa.** is a useful way to close a short interaction.

Even a beginner conversation can already have a complete shape: greet, communicate, then close.
